label: Google Play
description: Play Billing for the Android app. The website checkout provider stays Stripe.

settings.name: package_name
settings.label: Package name
settings.help: Android application id. Purchases are confirmed against this package.

settings.name: service_account_file
settings.label: Service account file
settings.help: Absolute path to the Play Console service-account JSON. The file stays outside the site and is not committed.

settings.name: notify_audience
settings.label: Notification audience
settings.help: Exact https address configured as the Pub/Sub push audience for google/notify. Empty ignores every notification.

settings.name: notify_email
settings.label: Notification sender
settings.help: The service account the Pub/Sub push subscription authenticates as (its email, e.g. play-notify@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com). Any Google account can sign a token for any audience, so a notification from another account is refused. Empty refuses every notification.

settings.name: choice_offer
settings.label: Offer ScoreTutor beside Google Play
settings.help: Yes shows the payment choice screen in the Android app. No opens the Google Play payment sheet for the plan that was clicked. Use No while Play billing choice is not active.

settings.name: choice_heading
settings.label: Heading
settings.default: How would you like to pay?

settings.name: choice_stripe_note
settings.label: Stripe note
settings.default: Pay by card. Continues in your browser.

settings.name: choice_no_play_product
settings.label: No Play product
settings.default: This plan is not available in Google Play.
settings.help: Under Google Play when the price row has no Google Play product ID

settings.name: choice_unavailable
settings.label: Not available
settings.default: Not available right now. Please try again later, or subscribe on the website.
settings.help: When Google Play Billing cannot connect: no payment in the app

settings.name: choice_error_start
settings.label: Error: not started
settings.default: The payment could not be started.

settings.name: choice_error_save
settings.label: Error: choice not saved
settings.default: The payment choice could not be saved.

settings.name: choice_error_checkout
settings.label: Error: checkout
settings.default: Checkout could not start. Try again.

settings.name: choice_error_play
settings.label: Error: Play purchase
settings.default: The Google Play purchase did not finish.

settings.name: choice_error_confirm
settings.label: Error: not confirmed
settings.default: The purchase could not be confirmed.

settings.name: choice_pending
settings.label: Pending
settings.default: Your payment is pending. Premium starts when Google confirms it.
